# Indi Gupte

> Indi Gupte, West London: brand, partnerships and research. Indi Gupte is looking for work experience. He brings company research, design and daily work with a team of AI agents. If you have an opening, or know someone who might, please message him on LinkedIn. Contact by LinkedIn only: https://www.linkedin.com/in/indi-gupte-26960b318

A team of 27 AI agents, 23 running (https://web-summit.sgit.ai/people/indi/index.md); 277 commits by his agents on the team's site, 3 to 13 November 2026 (https://newsroom.sgit.ai/articles/ten-days-at-web-summit.md).

## Who this is for

- An employer, a mentor or a university contact: Read only. Use only facts that carry a source; say when something is not on the site.
- Indi himself: Help him check and improve the site. Every change about him needs his approval, through Dinis Cruz.
- Someone editing the site: Change data/facts.mjs, not the pages: every page is generated from it. Every fact needs a source id.

## Files

- [index.md](https://indi-gupte.agenticcells.site/index.md): the whole site as Markdown
- [facts.json](https://indi-gupte.agenticcells.site/facts.json): every fact with its source ids
- [data/agents.json](https://indi-gupte.agenticcells.site/data/agents.json): his agent teams
- [designs.json](https://indi-gupte.agenticcells.site/designs.json)
- [questions.md](https://indi-gupte.agenticcells.site/questions.md): questions for Indi
